messages:
Olivia (CS): FYI customer asks to onboard 2 models into the gateway for Fjord Industrials — a 13B summarizer for maintenance logs and a 70B domain Q&A for procedures. They need private deployment (no raw logs off-prem), SLA around p50 100ms / p95 2s, expected peak ~30 rps. Also want safety evals for hallucination and IP leakage. Can eng + safety scope infra + evals?

Raj (Eng): got it. can you confirm exact model artifacts/names and whether the 70B is a vendor binary or something we need to host from a container? also any reqs for KMS/HSM?

Fjord POC: Model names: summarizer-redwood-13B-v1 (our fine-tune of an open base) and qna-domain-70b-v2 (vendor-supplied weights). Private deployment required; we cannot route raw logs through hosted services. We'll provide a redacted sample dataset (~1k entries) for eval.

Marta (Safety): Checklist starters: hallucination/regression evals against SOPs, verbatim leakage tests (sensitive serials/specs), instruction-following fidelity, and a refusal-sensitivity audit. They want fallback -> static KB when model confidence < 0.6. Also redirect any PHI/PII pipeline to on-prem scrubber before storage.

Liam (Solutions): recommend Dedicated capacity with canary + traffic-split rollout. For the summarizer suggest aggressive prefix caching; for 70B suggest quantization profile (int8 / mixed) and batching config to hit p95 target. sample rollout config I usually send:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 0.05
  steps: [0.25, 1.0]
  fallback: static_kb
  monitoring: [latency_p95, hallucination_rate, error_rate]
```

Raj (Eng): infra questions: 70B will likely need H100 or equivalent (we'll price both A100/H100 options). Are they ok with reserved nodes or prefer burstable? also confirm retention/eviction policy for KV cache. SLO?

Fjord POC: Need 99.95% uptime. Prefer reserved for predictability. KV cache retention: 6 hours max, must be able to flush on request.

DeployBot: Deployment calendar: slot opened Wed Mar 25 02:00 UTC — reserve with /deploy-request.

Kai (Oncall): flagging oncall coverage for initial 48h post-rollout. We'll rotate pager if go-live confirmed.

Olivia (CS): Action items: Raj - capacity & cost estimate by EOD; Marta - draft the safety eval checklist and pass sample tests; Liam - detailed rollout + quantization recs; Fjord POC - share redacted logs + acceptance criteria. I'll set architecture sync for tomorrow. @Raj @Marta @Liam any blockers? :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng): no blockers, I'll ping infra for H100 quotes.

Marta (Safety): will start checklist and mock eval harness. need sample SOP doc from customer to build ground-truth.

Liam (Solutions): will draft caching and batching config and share before sync.

Fjord POC: We'll upload sample logs and SOPs to the secure bucket by EOD. Thanks everyone.

Olivia (CS): perfect — will consolidate and send calendar invite.
